title: "Why Data-Centric AI Matters for Modern Data Products"
description: Data-centric AI prioritizes data quality and relevance over algorithm refinement, enabling superior model performance, scalability, fairness, and cost efficiency in building reliable, ethical, and personalized data products. By addressing challenges like bias and leveraging tools for efficient data processing, organizations can unlock the full potential of AI-driven innovation.

title: Data Centric AI | Using Knobs
description: Data Knobs is Data Centric AI company. Our mission is make data useble and useful. Instead of focusing on sophisticated algorithms we help businesses in buiding gold datasets. We use variety of approaches to build datasets for AI. We create new data, augment dataset, anonymize dataset. From Big data we focus on abstracting state action space so that optimal policy and learning can be done with well governed datasets.
